verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents automatic extraction of action items after every meeting, which covers the core of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows that action items are assigned to owners or gathered into a trackable list or board, and the AskFred line "What are my action items from this week's meetings?" is only an example query, not a documented tracking feature. Missing for 10: owner attribution of action items, a documented central place to collect and track action items across meetings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
